message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches data from Google Maps and HERE Map APIs via HTTP requests but performs no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision checks on the retrieved data.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, expected label set validation, or any label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) present in any of the code files shown.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs spatial filtering and data formatting but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports `load` from joblib and references a `Model` class, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed when loading serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and formats POI data but contains no checks for label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial robustness testing framework anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the visible code.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is visible in the inference data-flow path; subzone filtering is purely a spatial selection, not a security or validity guard.
No detected output bounds checks: No probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or threshold checks on model outputs are present in any of the visible code paths.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a scikit-learn/joblib ML model (POI conflation, TF-IDF, cosine similarity), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
